name: Westfield Recreation Ground Play Area
description: A recreation ground off Westfield Place with a play area, a zip wire, an exercise trail, a football goal, a basketball half court and a picnic area. OpenStreetMap calls it Westfield Road Play Area.

sources.label: Harpenden Town Council: Westfield Recreation Ground

notConfirmed: Exact position (taken from OpenStreetMap), age ranges, opening hours, toilets and parking. The pin is the playground on OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors) at the recreation ground.
